source.title: Cultivating Faith
source.objective: Receive the Seal of the Dawn.
source.progress:
I never imagined that the Scarlet Crusade and the Argent Dawn could put aside their differences and fight for a common good, but here we are.

Time and again, you've proven that our gamble's paid off. Retrieve more Remnants of Valor, champion. I feel that we're close to delivering our final blow to Kel'Thuzad and his ilk.
source.completion: Once again, I thank you, and once again, I'll prove my gratitude by empowering your seal.
